properties.content: Permanent Residence in Canada | Gateway Pacific Immigration Services The Canadian Immigration Procedure Permanent Residence in Canada Express Entry to Canada Canadian Work Permits & Business Immigration Study Permits in Canada Your Application About Us Testimonials News Contact Us BOOK A CONSULTATION Services The Canadian Immigration Procedure Permanent Residence in Canada Express Entry to Canada Canadian Work Permits & Business Immigration Study Permits in Canada Your Application About Us Testimonials News Contact Us Permanent Residence in Canada Achieving permanent residence in Canada is a life-changing opportunity, offering stability, security, and the chance to build a future in one of the world’s most welcoming countries. At Gateway Pacific Immigration, we specialize in guiding you through this complex process, ensuring a smooth transition to your new life in Canada. Whether you are drawn by Canada’s diverse culture, strong economy, or excellent quality of life, Gateway Pacific Immigration is here to help you every step of the way. Begin Your Path to Permanent Residency Why Choose Permanent Residence in Canada? Benefits of Permanent Canadian Residence Canadian permanent residence offers access to top-tier healthcare, education, and the freedom to live and work anywhere in the country. It is also a pathway to Canadian citizenship. Gateway Pacific Immigration is here to help you access these benefits. Make Canada Your Permanent Home Live, study or work anywhere in Canada As a Permanent Resident, you have the freedom to live in any province or territory, pursue education, work, or start a business without additional authorization from Immigration, Refugees, and Citizenship Canada (IRCC). Protection under Canadian Law Permanent Residents are protected by the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, granting you nearly all the same rights as Canadian citizens, including legal protections and freedom from discrimination. Full access to Canadian health care and social benefits Enjoy full access to Canada’s top-tier healthcare and social programs. As a PR, you also benefit from significantly reduced tuition fees—paying 2.5x less than international students. Apply for Canadian Citizenship After three years of residency, Permanent Residents can apply for Canadian citizenship, with the option to hold dual citizenship. Explore Your Pathways to Canadian Permanent Residence Permanent Residence Programs in Canada Canada offers a variety of Permanent Residence programs tailored to different needs and backgrounds, including the Express Entry system for skilled workers, the Provincial Nominee Program for those with provincial connections, and Family Sponsorship for reuniting loved ones. With so many options available, finding the right program can be complex. Gateway Pacific Immigration is here to guide you through this process, helping you identify the best program based on your unique circumstances and needs. Our expertise ensures you choose the most suitable pathway to achieve your Canadian permanent residency. Start Your PR Application Today Bring Your Family Over to Canada Family Sponsorship Permanent Residents in Canada have the opportunity to sponsor their partners, children, parents, and grandparents for permanent residency. In some exceptional cases, it is also possible to sponsor more distant relatives. This program allows families to reunite and build a future together in Canada. Get to Canada, Quickly Express Entry Canada’s Express Entry system is the premier pathway to Permanent Residence, encompassing three key programs: the Federal Skilled Worker Program, the Canadian Experience Class, and the Federal Skilled Trades Program. This comprehensive system is designed to streamline the application process for skilled workers and professionals. Regional Opportunities for Skilled Professionals Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) The Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) offers an alternative route to Permanent Residence through provincial governments. This program is ideal for students, workers, and business owners who have skills or experience that meet the needs of specific provinces and territories. Permanent Residence for Canadian Work Experience Canadian Experience Class The Canadian Experience Class, part of the Express Entry system, is designed for individuals with at least one year of full-time skilled work experience in Canada. Applicants must demonstrate proficiency in English and/or French to qualify for this program. Criteria-Based Immigration for Skilled Professionals Federal Skilled Worker Program The Federal Skilled Worker Program is a key component of the Express Entry system, targeting individuals with a strong combination of education, work experience, and age. Proficiency in English and/or French is also required to be eligible for this program.
